takes place on an island in the ocean. The map's style is similar to old Roblox games, with studded parts. On the island, there is a house, a lighthouse and a dock, with multiple cliffs, trees and rocks scattered across the map.
The brown path starts at a cave and ends at a house. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding the cliffs.

Cliff towers can be very useful here, as this map has a large amount of cliffs.
Cliff towers should be placed near the lighthouse, as this spot allows them to cover most of the map.
Ground towers should generally be placed around the beginning of the map.
